title: The twist sectors split into whole and half-integer harmonics of the shear
subject: Which relations among the four twist sectors of the knot's critical emergence are exact, and why shear breaks additivity
conclusion: On square-lattice tori, shearing by the width relabels the four twist sectors and the mirror maps each sector to itself, for every orientation, so the effect of the second twist splits into a part with whole harmonics of the shear and a part with only half-integer harmonics that vanishes at half shear. Additivity of P(all strong components contractible) across the sectors is therefore a relation of one basis, dephased by any shear, and it is not exact at finite size.
